question: Major Malla Rama Gopal Naidu of the Maratha Light Infantry of the Indian Army was awarded with which of the following honours in May 25?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kirti Chakra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Major Malla Rama Gopal Naidu** of the **Maratha Light Infantry** was awarded the **Kirti Chakra** on May 25 for his exceptional bravery and service.
 
• The **Kirti Chakra** is India's second-highest peacetime gallantry award, awarded for conspicuous bravery or acts of valor during peacetime.
 
• This award recognizes individuals who display exceptional bravery in non-combat situations, including counter-terrorism operations and disaster response.
 
• The Kirti Chakra can be awarded posthumously, but in this case, Major Malla Rama Gopal Naidu received it for his valor without it being posthumous.
 
• Recipients of the Kirti Chakra are honored for their outstanding courage and self-sacrifice in the service of the nation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Gallantry Awards in India:**

 
 
• India has instituted several gallantry awards to recognize courage and valor displayed by individuals in service, both during wartime and peacetime.
 
• The awards include **Param Vir Chakra**, **Maha Vir Chakra**, **Vir Chakra**, **Kirti Chakra**, **Shaurya Chakra**, and **Ashoka Chakra**.
 
• The Kirti Chakra is awarded for acts of gallantry other than in the face of the enemy.
 
• It ranks second in the order of precedence among peacetime gallantry awards, after the Ashoka Chakra.
 
 
 
• **Maratha Light Infantry:**
 
 
• The Maratha Light Infantry is one of the oldest regiments in the Indian Army, established in **1768**.
 
• The regiment has a long history of bravery and has participated in many battles, including the **Kargil War** and World War II.
 
• It is known for its motto, "**Duty, Honour, Courage**," which reflects its commitment to the nation.
 
 
 
• **Criteria for Kirti Chakra:**
 
 
• It is awarded to military personnel, civilian citizens, and members of the police forces for their courage in non-combat operations.
 
• Acts such as saving lives during natural calamities, fighting insurgency, and preventing significant loss of life are recognized.
 
 
 
• **Other Gallantry Awards:**
 
 
• The **Shaurya Chakra** is the third-highest peacetime gallantry award in India, given for acts of courage and bravery.
 
• The **Param Vir Chakra** is the highest wartime gallantry award in India, given for the most conspicuous bravery or self-sacrifice in the face of the enemy.
 
• The **Ashoka Chakra** is the highest peacetime gallantry award, awarded for valor, courageous action, or self-sacrifice away from the battlefield.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Kirti Chakra Design:**

 
 
• The medal is circular, made of silver, and has a design featuring a chakra (wheel) in the center.
 
• The ribbon is green with a central orange stripe, symbolizing courage and bravery.
 
 
 
• **Posthumous Award:**
 
 
• The Kirti Chakra can be awarded posthumously, ensuring recognition for those who sacrifice their lives for the nation.
 
 
 
• **Other Award Categories:**
 
 
• Gallantry awards are classified into wartime and peacetime categories, each with unique criteria for selection.
 
• Both military and civilian personnel are eligible for these awards, depending on their acts of valor.
